objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched or selected (AD1). The audit re-assesses the completed risk-envelope pilot's already-evaluated candidates under nine predeclared risk-envelope policies (POLICY_MATRIX.md); the frozen P0 and RA1-original selectors are re-applied as labelled counterfactual selectors only.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity); the counterfactual policies P1-P8 are report-only views, never a change of the standard's ceiling

budget.notes: No search proposals. backendEvaluations caps the bounded non-official CPU replays of fixed, already-evaluated configurations (PROTOCOL.md section 5: G1 confirmation gap fill, G2 giveback-attribution path replays, G3 parity samples). The archive replays of the pilot's lanes and qualifications are zero-evaluation (every request must be an archive hit).

evaluationBackend.justification: Retrospective diagnostic audit of a completed study (brief section 8): archived GPU records are re-assessed with zero evaluations; the only evaluations are bounded CPU replays of exactly the fixed configurations listed in PROTOCOL.md section 5, each parity-checked against the archived official GPU record. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8).

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search, no selection and no chronological verdict (AD2); sealed next-interval records of the pilot are restated only as retrospective, previously inspected history

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; the frozen P0 / RA1-original selectors are re-applied only as labelled counterfactual selectors on archived populations
deviations.justification: brief sections 5 and 8: rescore and requalify archived evaluations; do not adopt a candidate

deviations.description: no search, no earlier-cutoff repeat, no chronological verdict; no D23 or FULL opening
deviations.justification: brief sections 0 and 8: no new genetic search or optimization; reuse sealed interval results
